SELECT DISTINCT * FROM sys_menu where is_del = 0
and menu_type IN
#{item}
and menu_name like CONCAT('%',#{params.menuName},'%')

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m. NAME, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.visible, m. STATUS, m.request_uri, ifnull(m.perms, '') AS perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_map_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_map_role_user ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.menu_type IN ('M', 'C') AND m.STATUS = 0 AND m.is_del = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m. NAME, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.`query`, m.visible, m. STATUS, m.request_uri, ifnull(m.perms, '') AS perms, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_map_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN sys_map_role_user ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.STATUS = 0 AND m.is_del = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.name, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.path, m.component, m.request_uri, ifnull(m.perms, '') AS perms, m.`query`, m.visible, m. STATUS, m.is_frame, m.is_cache, m.menu_type, m.icon, m.order_num, m.create_time FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.STATUS = 0 and m.menu_type in ('M','C')
AND m.sys_menu_type in
#{item}
AND m.is_del = 0 ORDER BY m.parent_id, m.order_num
SELECT m.* FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.parent_id = #{parentId} AND m.menu_type = 'F' AND m.is_del = 0 AND m. STATUS = 0 ORDER BY m.order_num ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_menu m LEFT JOIN sys_map_role_menu mrm ON mrm.menu_id = m.id LEFT JOIN sys_map_role_user mru ON mru.role_id = mrm.role_id WHERE m.parent_id = #{parentId} AND m.menu_type = 'F' AND m.is_del = 0 AND m. STATUS = 0 AND mru.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.order_num ASC, m.id ASC
